title: Shared Kanbus boards honor the Chatticus theme and authorized project scope
description:
As a user, I want a familiar board that stays readable in my chosen theme and only reveals authorized projects.

Proposed acceptance behavior for future implementation; not executable proof or a delivery claim.

```gherkin
Feature: Themeable scoped project boards
  Scenario: Change the workspace theme
    Given I am viewing an authorized project Kanbus board
    When I switch between the supported light and dark workspace themes
    Then the board and issue details remain legible and usable
    And the selected project and issue state remain unchanged
  Scenario: Attempt to open an unauthorized project board
    Given a project board is outside my permitted scope
    When I attempt to open it
    Then its issue content is not disclosed
```

Design/acceptance questions before implementation: Specify membership/tenant/account/project boundaries and refusal behavior, including changed membership and stale selection. Verify dependency compatibility and accessibility. Implementation constraint: use @kanbus/ui shared Board/card/detail components and supported styling hooks; upstream reusable gaps instead of duplicating a Chatticus board.
right_now_summary: The team is defining theme support and access rules for shared Kanbus project boards.
